snippet.title: The Backworld ► Release Window Trailer
snippet.description:
CHECK IT OUT HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1871640/The_Backworld/?utm_source=ShowcaseFall26

Slip between the cracks of reality into a world where danger awaits at every turn. Survive with strategy, battling when necessary or fleeing when the odds are stacked against you. Collect strange items, unlock new abilities, and recruit unique companions. Forge your own path; every choice matters.
